papers.title: Laser energy absorption behavior of powder particles using ray tracing method during selective laser melting additive manufacturing of aluminum alloy

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铝合金SLM工艺中的激光能量吸收，与生物医用植入体无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no porous structure design, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), and no assessment of osseointegration or stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM过程中粉末颗粒对激光能量的吸收行为。
summary_zh.method: 采用射线追踪方法模拟粉末床中激光能量的分布与吸收。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了粉末粒径和排列对能量吸收效率的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 仅通过仿真验证，无实验对比。

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the laser energy absorption behavior of powder particles during selective laser melting process.
summary_en.method: Employ ray tracing method to simulate the distribution and absorption of laser energy in powder bed.
summary_en.result: Reveal the effect of particle size and packing on energy absorption efficiency.
